ADDED i1: Tests {@link Symmetry454Date#getLong(TemporalField)}.

Background on the Symmetry454 calendar, which the expected values rely on:

  • A regular year has
ADDED i2: Verifies that querying a field on a {@link Symmetry454Date} returns the expected value. Each date is given as a (year, month, dayOfMonth) triple.
ADDED i3: --- Mid-year date in a regular year: 2014-05-26 --- May is the second month of quarter 2, so it is a 35-day (5-week) month.
ADDED i4: Day-of-year = days in months 1..4 (28+35+28+28) plus 26 days into May.
ADDED i5: Aligned-week-of-year = weeks in months 1..4 (4+5+4+4) plus 4 weeks into May.
ADDED i6: Proleptic-month counts months since the proleptic year 0 (zero-based).
ADDED i7: Era is CE (1) regardless of the year.
ADDED i8: --- Date in the third quarter: 2012-09-26 --- September is the last month of quarter 3, so two full quarters precede it.
ADDED i9: Day-of-year = 3 quarters of (4+5+4) weeks * 7 days, minus the last 2 days.
ADDED i10: Aligned-week-of-year = 3 quarters of (4+5+4) weeks.
ADDED i11: --- Last day of a leap year: 2015-12-35 (leap December has 35 days) ---
ADDED i12: Day-of-year = 4 quarters of (4+5+4) weeks * 7 days, plus the extra leap week.
ADDED i13: 52 regular weeks plus the leap week makes week 53.
ADDED i14: Proleptic-month for the last month of 2015 = (months through 2016) - 1.
